articles.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost
articles.snippet: Some smaller hedge funds with weaker security controls may have lost funds in the targeted attack, sources said.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs over $80,000 as crypto shakes off Clarity failure and higher interest rates
articles.snippet: Another central bank hiked rates overnight, this time the Bank of Japan. The move failed to halt the slide in the yen.

articles.title: UK signals end of 'light-touch' era with multi-agency raid on peer-to-peer crypto hubs
articles.snippet: Increased enforcement coincides with detailed regulatory guidance issued to crypto firms ahead of the full framework taking effect in late 2027.

articles.title: Binance launches 24/7 FX perps with weekend pricing system
articles.snippet: Binance is joining a growing number of crypto exchanges offering around-the-clock exposure to foreign exchange markets through perpetual futures.

articles.title: Crypto stocks rebound after CLARITY Act selloff
articles.snippet: Coinbase, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks rallied Friday as the CFTC and SEC moved ahead with crypto-related actions under existing authority.
